When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

Parexel are currently recruiting for an Clinical Supply Support Specialist Services to join one of our growing sponsors in Spain.

Key Responsibilities:

Clinical Supply & Inventory Planning & Execution

  • Supply monitoring, assessment and oversight activities (risks, stocking levels, trends)

  • Pull relevant data for metrics reporting & maintain metrics

  • Process requisitions and ensure timely procurement of comparator drugs & ancillary supplies

  • Track and manage comparator documentation updates

Clinical Supply Shipments

  • Initiate non-system generated shipments

  • Monitor and track comparator drug delivery schedules

  • Coordinate Depot transfers & site return shipments

  • Temperature excursion management and resolution

Clinical Supply Monitoring & Activity Documentation (Electronic Trial Master File - eTMF)

  • Expected Document List (EDL) creation

  • Update comparator IMN (Item Master Number)

  • Update and maintain eTMF Document Management per regulatory requirements

  • Request QA/QP Releases

  • Pack-and-label kit and sequence reconciliation

  • Inspection Readiness activities

  • IRT management activities, including IRT Alert management and UAT activities

IP / Ancillary Supplies Compatibility Review

  • Receive and triage request, forward to FDG for review

  • Perform internet searches and contact manufacturers for information

  • Data entry of information into database (ASIST or spreadsheet) and Teams

Clinical Supply Systems

  • Manage CSS Email Inbox

  • Manage IRT system access for users for all studies

  • Complete EDL, IRR and StiL reviews every 3 months for all studies

  • Manage all TMF documentation uploads into VEEVA

  • Assist in UAT testing

Minimum Years of Experience:

Minimum education requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in a related field with an internship or prior industry work experience.

2+ years of experience in the following fields:

  • Clinical Supplies

  • QA/Regulatory

  • Precision Medicine

  • Supply Chain

  • Manufacturing

  • Procurement

  • Or equivalent research/commercial biopharma experience

If you are interested, please apply or send your CV to marta.kuniewicz@parexel.com

raw.description:
The Senior Accountant of the Metal Solutions accounting team will be responsible for performing tasks across multiple ERPs and assisting with process and control standardization efforts across multiple teams. The ideal candidate will have exposure to multiple accounting systems and working with teams in a remote environment, while possessing strong analytical skills and being able to manage multiple tasks efficiently. Reporting to the Metal Solutions Accounting Supervisor, the Senior Accountant will assist in overseeing financial operations, ensuring compliance with accounting standards, supporting the monthly accounting close and related tasks, and providing strategic financial insights to support business decisions.

In this role, you will be responsible for supporting the monthly accounting close and related tasks, including but not limited to preparing financial reports, performing account reconciliations, maintaining the general ledger and performing other assigned duties. Additionally, the Senior Accountant will assist in enhancing the monthly close, consolidation, and internal reporting processes.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Manage month-end and year-end closing processes
  • Reconcile accounts and resolve discrepancies
  • Oversee daily general ledger activities across multiple ERPs
  • Conduct financial analysis of key metrics and generate reports to support management decisions
  • Prepare (and review) journal entries in accordance with US GAAP
  • Provide ad-hoc support to Division and Segment leadership
  • Assist in budgeting and forecasting activities
  • Ensure compliance with internal controls and company policies
  • Coordinate and assist with internal / external audit requests
  • Assist with developing and carrying out process improvement initiatives
  • Continued focus on improving system efficiencies and business practices
  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, or related field; CPA or CMA certification preferred
  • Minimum of 3 years of accounting experience, with a progression of responsibilities
  • Proficiency in accounting software (Oracle R12, NetSuite, JDE, Epicor) preferred
  • Strong knowledge of GAAP and financial reporting
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

The US base salary range for this full-time position is $85,000-$105,000 + bonus + medical, dental, vision benefits starting day 1 + 401k and PTO. raw.description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Consumer Engagement Representative 1 oversees the enrollment, education, engagement, and activation duties for client groups regardless of segment, and for product where warranted. The Consumer Engagement Representative 1 performs basic administrative/clerical/operational/customer support/computational tasks. Typically works on routine and patterned assignments.

The Consumer Engagement Representative 1 plays a key role in Humana's Rx Education/Enrollment team within CenterWell Pharmacy by helping members understand their pharmacy benefit options, supporting members in transitioning from retail to mail-order services when appropriate, and supporting strategic initiatives that elevate consumer experience and drive continuous improvement.

This position requires strong communication skills, emotional intelligence, and a passion for helping customers make informed decisions that improve convenience and support better health outcomes.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Serve as an expert in mail-order pharmacy benefits, including medication delivery timelines, refill processes, and savings potential.
  • Use motivational education techniques to guide and inform members during live calls.
  • Accurately assess customer needs and offer personalized solutions that prioritize ease, care, and health benefit alignment.
  • Navigate systems to identify appropriate enrollment opportunities and execute required steps with accuracy.
  • Adhere to scripting protocols while maintaining a natural, member-centered conversation style.
  • Partners with supervisors and QA teams to continuously improve call quality and meet conversion goals.
  • Support special campaigns or seasonal initiatives, such as the Annual Enrollment Period (AEP), as needed.
  • Maintain confidentiality, professionalism, and empathy in all interactions, especially when handling sensitive health or medication concerns.


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent required
  • 1+ years experience in customer service, consumer engagement, pharmacy benefit, healthcare or related operational roles.
  • Must reside in one of the following approved WAH state locations: AZ, TX, FL, OH, NC, KY, IN, CO, OK, TN, VA.
  • Meet all Work at Home (WAH) eligibility requirements including but not limited to: ability to provide & maintain satisfactory internet speeds (set by Humana) and separate workspace to perform job duties without distraction.
  • Ability to work in a structured, metric-driven environment with daily, weekly, and monthly performance goals.
  • Comfortable navigating multiple systems and documentation tools simultaneously, and reporting insights to leadership staff.
  • Commitment to protecting member privacy and complying with all regulatory guidelines.
  • Must be passionate about contributing to an organization focused on continuously improving consumer experiences.

Preferred Experience

  • 2+ years experience in customer service, consumer engagement, pharmacy benefit, healthcare or related operational roles.
  • Experience supporting enrollment, benefits, client education, or healthcare-related engagement programs.
  • Experience leveraging technology platforms, CRM systems, or digital engagement tools to support consumer or client interactions.
  • Intermediate to advanced experience with Microsoft suite (i.e., Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Familiarity with PBM systems, Humana tools, or pharmacy benefit structures.
  • Associate degree or higher
  • Bilingual (Spanish/English) a plus.

Additional Information

  • This is a Work at Home (WAH) opportunity. Must reside in one of the following state locations: AZ, TX, FL, OH, NC, KY, IN, CO, OK, TN, VA.
  • Able to work a shift M-F, during hours of operation 8a-8p EST; with the possibility of a Saturdays and or Sunday shift during the hours of 8:00am -6:30pm EST.
  • Training is provided and will include compliance, systems navigation, motivational education, and product knowledge.

Additional Information:

As part of our hiring process for this opportunity, we will be using an interviewing technology called HireVue to enhance our hiring and decision-making ability. HireVue allows us to quickly connect and gain valuable information from you pertaining to your relevant skills and experience at a time that is best for your schedule.

Work at home requirements:

To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees' ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria:

At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested.

Satellite, cellular and microwave connection can be used only if approved by leadership.

Employees who live and work from Home in the state of California, Illinois, Montana, or South Dakota will be provided a bi-weekly payment for their internet expense.

Humana will provide Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees with telephone equipment appropriate to meet the business requirements for their position/job.

Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.

SSN Alert:

Humana values personal identity protection. Please be aware that applicants may be asked to provide their Social Security Number, if it is not already on file. When required, an email will be sent from Humana@myworkday.com with instructions on how to add the information into your official application on Humana's secure website.

Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Pay Range

The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc.$40,000 - $52,300 per yearThis job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.

Description of Benefits

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, volunteer time off, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.


About us

About CenterWell Pharmacy: CenterWell Pharmacy provides convenient, safe, reliable pharmacy services and is committed to excellence and quality. Through our home delivery and over-the-counter fulfillment services, specialty, and retail pharmacy locations, we provide customers simple, integrated solutions every time. The result is high-quality healthcare that is accessible, comprehensive and, most of all, personalized. As the largest provider of senior-focused primary care, a leading provider of home healthcare and a leading integrated home delivery, specialty, hospice and retail pharmacy, CenterWell is focused on whole health and addressing the physical, emotional and social wellness of our patients. CenterWell is part of Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM). Learn more about what we offer at CenterWell.com.

FUNCTIONAL SKILLS

  • Ability to map and document complex systems and data flows; advanced analytical and problem-solving skills, including competency with tooling such as Lucid chart, Visio, Excel – Required

  • Advanced analytical and problem solving skills with strong attention to detail – Required

Shape the future of how the world's biggest Salesforce teams build, protect, and innovate.

Location: Remote (US) / Pleasanton, CA

Reports to: Chief Executive Officer

Why This Role Matters

Every day, the world's most mission-critical companies — banks, hospitals, governments, and Fortune 500 enterprises — run on Salesforce. And every day, the teams behind those orgs face a choice: move fast or stay safe. At Flosum, we refuse that tradeoff. As the only 100% Salesforce-native DevSecOps, data, and security platform, we empower teams to ship fearlessly, recover instantly, and govern with confidence — all without leaving the platform they love.

We're looking for a visionary product leader who sees what's possible when innovation and trust live in the same place. Someone who wants to leave a fingerprint on an entire ecosystem.

The Opportunity

This is more than a product role — it's a chance to architect the operating system for the modern Salesforce enterprise. You will own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for a platform that touches release managers at sunrise, developers at midnight, and CISOs every minute in between. You'll lead a passionate team of product managers, partner shoulder-to-shoulder with brilliant engineers, and sit at the table with customers solving problems that matter — from accelerating releases by 10x to recovering an org in minutes after a catastrophic event.

If you've ever wanted to build the category-defining product in Salesforce DevOps, this is your moment.

What You'll Do

  • Set the North Star. Craft a bold, multi-year product vision that anticipates where Salesforce — and the AI-powered enterprise — is heading next, from Agentforce to Data Cloud and beyond.
  • Build the team that builds the future. Recruit, mentor, and inspire a world-class product organization across DevOps, data management, and security — a team people fight to join and never want to leave.
  • Obsess over customers. Sit with admins, developers, release managers, and security leaders. Understand their 2 a.m. anxieties and their 10 a.m. ambitions. Turn those insights into products they'll champion.
  • Ship things that matter. Drive the full lifecycle — from messy whiteboard to flawless launch — for capabilities like Git-based version control, AI-assisted code review, intelligent backup & recovery, and zero-trust security.
  • Stay ahead of the platform. Turn every Salesforce release into an opportunity, not a fire drill, ensuring Flosum is always first and always native.
  • Win the category. Outthink and outmaneuver every competitor by knowing the market deeper than anyone else and telling a story only Flosum can tell.
  • Be a force multiplier. Partner with marketing, sales, success, and AppExchange & SI partners to turn great products into great businesses.

Requirements

Who You Are

  • A product leader with 10+ years of experience and the scars and wins to prove it — including 3+ years building and leading PM teams.
  • A Salesforce native at heart — you dream in metadata, you've debugged a deployment at midnight, and you know why governor limits exist (and how to live with them).
  • A builder who has shipped DevOps, ALM, data protection, or security products that customers genuinely love.
  • A strategist who can paint the 5-year picture and an operator who can ship next Tuesday.
  • A storyteller comfortable in front of a single customer, a packed room, an analyst, or a board.
  • A magnet for talent and a champion of the people you lead.

Bonus Superpowers

  • Deep fluency in Git, CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps), and modern developer workflows.
  • Experience with backup, archival, sandbox seeding, and data masking at enterprise scale.
  • Battle-tested in regulated environments — SOC 2, HIPAA, FedRAMP, GDPR.
  • A point of view on how AI will reshape the Salesforce admin and developer experience — and the chops to ship it.
  • Salesforce certifications, an engineering background, or an MBA that sharpens your edge.

What Success Looks Like

  • One year from now, you will have published a roadmap the entire ecosystem talks about, built a team that's the envy of the industry, and shipped releases that move ARR, expand customer relationships, and cement Flosum as the undisputed leader on the AppExchange. Five years from now, you'll look back at a category you helped define — and an enterprise software movement you helped lead.

    If you're ready to do the most meaningful work of your career, we're ready to build it with you.

The Director, PST and Boundary Systems Transformation will serve as the primary leader for OSCQ DT’s S4 program coordination - owning roadmap alignment, cross-team orchestration, and ensuring that OSCQ dependencies, milestones, and system readiness are fully integrated into the enterprise S4 program plan. They will drive the harmonization, rationalization, and modernization of 100+ OSCQ boundary applications and related data products and ensure system capabilities, integration approaches, and data flows evolve in step with process redesign efforts and S4 deployment plans.

Why This Role Matters: The S4 transformation is critical to enabling standardized processes, operational agility, and scalable digital capabilities across OSCQ. Success will position the organization to support advanced planning, digital supply chain and manufacturing, and data-driven operations while reducing complexity and cost.

What You Will Do

Transformation Leadership & Strategy

  • Lead the rationalization and modernization of OSCQ boundary systems and associated data products following a clear disposition strategy (retain, retire, replace, consolidate, re-platform).
  • Align OSCQ DT transformation roadmaps with the S4 program strategy, technology architecture, and deployment sequencing.
  • Ensure the S4 roadmap is fully synchronized with all relevant OSCQ digital transformation roadmaps (MES, boundary systems, data platforms, manufacturing digital initiatives).
  • Serve as the technical counterpart to OSCQ process transformation leads, ensuring system capabilities and integration support intended process outcomes.
  • Drive process harmonization, system standardization, and tech debt reduction to simplify the application landscape and reduce cost.

Program Execution & Delivery

  • Own end-to-end boundary systems transformation and simplification including scoping, implementation, cross-team coordination, risk mitigation, and program mgmt.
  • Partner with DT, PST, and OSCQ teams to ensure roadmap changes, risks, and impacts are communicated and incorporated into the broader PST plan and schedule.
  • Lead the S4 workstream aligned to PST and OSCQ’s process change management team, ensuring coordinated roadmaps, deliverables, and dependencies.
  • Serve as the overall S4 program coordination leader for OSCQ DT - managing dependencies, deliverables, risk logs, and ensuring all workstreams align to the enterprise S4 schedule.
  • Consolidate OSCQ DT’s S4 plans into a single integrated schedule and ensure cross-functional adherence and visibility.

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Facilitate decision-making forums to resolve tradeoffs between local site needs and enterprise standardization.
  • Influence senior OSCQ stakeholders to drive process/tool harmonization and simplification.
  • Lead OSCQ DT’s representation within S4 governance, steering committees, and cross-functional workshops.
  • Technical & Process Governance
  • Run governance and decision frameworks for system disposition, process harmonization, and prioritization.
  • Ensure alignment with cross-functional teams to ensure roadmaps and integration plans are aligned.
  • Drive and report on process harmonization, system simplification, and cost reduction.

Change Leadership & Adoption

  • Drive stakeholder alignment and executive communication related to boundary systems readiness, milestones, and site deployment impact.
  • Ensure successful adoption through ensuring proper change management and operational transition planning is in place.

Success Metrics

  • System readiness milestones met in parallel with OSCQ process transformation timelines
  • Demonstrated alignment between S4 program milestones and interconnected digital transformation programs
  • Reduction in boundary applications and duplicate capabilities
  • Reduced technical debt and support burden
  • Improved data consistency and interoperability
  • On-time delivery of transformation roadmap milestones

Qualifications You must Have

  • Typically requires a University Degree or equivalent experience and minimum 14 years of prior relevant experience, or an Advanced Degree in a related field and minimum 12 years of experience
  • 10+ years leading digital transformation programs in manufacturing, supply chain, or quality environments
  • Experience rationalizing complex application landscapes and driving application/platform consolidation
  • Experience coordinating across business, IT, architecture, and site operations
  • Program leadership experience in multi-site, matrixed organizations
  • Experience delivering enterprise system transformations (ERP, MES, Quality, or supply chain platforms)

Qualifications We Prefer

  • Aerospace & defense, industrial manufacturing, or regulated environments
  • Industry 4.0 and digital manufacturing initiatives
  • Lean process transformation and harmonization
  • Leadership Competencies
  • Enterprise thinker who balances standardization with operational realities
  • Exceptional at driving clarity in complex environments
  • Strong executive communication and influence skills
  • Structured decision-making and governance leadership
  • Bias toward simplification and scalable solutions

What We Offer

  • Our values—Safety, Trust, Respect, Accountability, Collaboration, and Innovation—drive our actions, behaviors, and performance with a vision for a safer, more connected world.

raw.excerpt: Descripción general del rol Estamos buscando un/a Senior DevOps / Site Reliability Engineer para cubrir el turno nocturno de fines de semana, con responsabilidad directa sobre la continuidad operativa de infraestructuras cloud y on-premise en entornos productivos reales.
raw.description:
Descripción general del rol Estamos buscando un/a Senior DevOps / Site Reliability Engineer para cubrir el turno nocturno de fines de semana, con responsabilidad directa sobre la continuidad operativa de infraestructuras cloud y on-premise en entornos productivos reales.
  • Este es un rol altamente técnico y senior.
  • Diseñado para profesionales con experiencia sólida en operaciones críticas.
  • Requiere trabajar de forma autónoma y tomar decisiones técnicas durante el turno.
  • Dar continuidad a tareas y proyectos iniciados por otros miembros del equipo.
Importante:
  • No es un rol de soporte básico.
  • No es L1/L2.
  • Es un rol de operación, decisión y responsabilidad real.
Objetivo del puesto Asegurar la estabilidad, disponibilidad y correcto funcionamiento de la infraestructura durante el turno nocturno de fines de semana, cuando los equipos completos no están online. Responsabilidades clave:
  • Mantener el uptime y los SLA.
  • Resolver incidencias críticas en producción.
  • Evitar interrupciones del negocio.
  • Garantizar una correcta continuidad entre turnos.
Responsabilidades principales Durante el turno, la persona a cargo debe:
  • Monitorear proactivamente la infraestructura y los servicios cloud.
  • Gestionar y resolver incidencias críticas durante la noche.
  • Dar continuidad a tareas técnicas y proyectos iniciados por otros equipos.
  • Aplicar buenas prácticas de DevOps, automatización y observabilidad.
  • Supervisar y mantener pipelines CI/CD.
  • Administrar sistemas Linux a nivel avanzado.
  • Gestionar contenedores Docker y orquestación con Kubernetes.
  • Administrar entornos cloud (AWS y/o Azure).
  • Trabajar con virtualización (KVM / VMware).
  • Gestionar redes, almacenamiento y seguridad.
  • Colaborar en tareas propias de un data center y entornos de cloud empresarial.
  • Dejar documentación y contexto claro para el siguiente turno.
Entorno tecnológico
  • Multi-cliente y multi-cloud.
  • Linux (administración avanzada).
  • AWS y/o Azure.
  • Docker & Kubernetes.
  • CI/CD (Jenkins, GitLab CI u otros).
  • Virtualización (VMware, KVM).
  • Networking, storage y políticas de seguridad.
Este no es un entorno de laboratorio; se trabaja con infraestructura real en producción.
Perfil que buscamos Persona que:
  • Tenga seniority real en operaciones.
  • Pueda trabajar cómoda y responsablemente de forma independiente.
  • Tenga experiencia resolviendo incidentes críticos.
  • Sepa priorizar bajo presión.
  • Sea organizada y clara en la comunicación entre turnos.
  • Posea una mirada multidisciplinar (cloud y on-premise).
Requisitos
  • Experiencia mínima de 5 años en administración de sistemas Linux (idealmente 8+).
  • Experiencia en entornos cloud, data center y operaciones críticas.
  • Experiencia real en roles DevOps / SRE con autonomía total.
  • Conocimiento sólido de Docker, Kubernetes y CI/CD.
Formación:
  • Ingeniería de Sistemas, Informática o carreras afines.
  • Certificaciones Cloud / DevOps valoradas pero no sustituyen la experiencia.
Habilidades valoradas
  • Alta autonomía.
  • Capacidad para resolución de incidentes críticos.
  • Perfil técnico multidisciplinar.
  • Organización y compromiso.
  • Foco en la continuidad operativa.
Horario y modalidad
  • Días: Sábados y domingos.
  • Horario: 22:00 a 08:00 (zona horaria España, CET).
  • Carga horaria: 20 horas semanales.
Ideal para perfiles senior que buscan:
  • Alta responsabilidad técnica.
  • Menor carga horaria semanal.
  • Trabajo enfocado con impacto real.
Idiomas
  • Español: requerido.
  • Inglés: valorado.
Por qué puede ser interesante este rol
  • Rol senior, técnico y autónomo.
  • Entornos modernos y variados.
  • Decisiones reales en producción.
  • Sin tareas de soporte básico.
  • Formar parte de un equipo con foco en calidad operativa.

raw.title: Premium Audit Coordinator (Part-Time, Remote)
raw.excerpt: Our Story Imagine being part of a team that’s not just shaping the future but actively driving it.
raw.description:
Our Story
Imagine being part of a team that’s not just shaping the future but actively driving it. At Davies North America, we’re at the forefront of innovation and excellence, blending cutting-edge technology with top-tier professional services. As a vital part of the global Davies Group, we help businesses navigate risk, optimize operations, and spearhead transformation in the insurance and regulated sectors.

What's in Store
Davies Risk Services is looking for an experienced Premium Audit Coordinator who will work directly with the branch team to provide assistant functions to our field representatives. Reporting to the Branch Manager, you will perform a variety of tasks related to the preparation of reports and appointments. You will also spend time completing inbound calls with insureds and audit representatives to encourage the appropriate preparation for upcoming premium audits.

Key Responsibilities

  • Acts as a liaison between the Phone Audit Manager and Phone Auditors to facilitate the flow of work
  • High call volume averaging 8-12 calls per hour during business hours
  • Acts as a liaison between insureds and field representatives when setting up audit or inspection appointments
  • Assists with determining needs, scheduling or cancelling appointments, or referring the insured to the correct staff person
  • Correspond with policyholders, CPA’s, bookkeepers, agents to gather additional information as needed
  • Communicates audit needs to the insured to help ensure information is prepared for the Phone Auditor
  • Maintains and updates contact notes on each assigned job in AuSum
  • Makes calls to check on status of information including insurance agent calls
  • Handles all calls in a professional and welcoming manner and uses tact when explaining this process and reasoning for the inquiry
  • Attaches information and adds progress notes as it becomes available in AuSum
  • Assigns audits to Phone Auditors once information is received
  • Other duties as assigned
This is a part-time (29 hours per week), remote role.

Skills, knowledge & expertise

  • Professional phone, chat, and email communication
  • High School Diploma or GED
  • Excellent computer skills including experience in the Microsoft Office Suite
  • Commitment to providing exceptional customer service
  • Communication: Balancing listening and talking, speaking, and writing clearly and accurately, influencing others, keeping others informed
  • Attention to Detail: Listen to information from policyholders and clients alike
  • Efficiency: Planning, managing time well, being on time, being cost conscious, thinking of better ways to do things
  • Multitasking: Handles distractions well, adaptable to new responsibilities; ability to quickly switch between tasks and adapt to changes easily
  • Proactive, independent, and takes initiative with consistent follow through
  • Superb communication skills, verbal and written, conducted in a timely manner
  • Superior time management skills with capability of working with and meeting deadlines
  • Exceptional capability to multi-task and prioritize with excellent organization and documentation skills in a fast-paced, dynamic work environment
  • Excellent team player with interpersonal skills
  • High level attention to detail and problem-solving skills
  • Capable of working collaboratively and independently with minimal supervision
  • Exhibit discretion with sensitive and confidential information
  • Display a comfort level working with key people at all levels within an organization

Equal Employment Opportunity & Legal Notices

Benefits
At Davies North America, we are dedicated to supporting the well‑being and future of our qualifying employees. Our comprehensive benefits package includes:
  • Medical, dental, and vision plans to support your health and that of your family
  • A 401(k) plan with employer matching
  • Time‑off policies, including Discretionary Time Off (DTO) for exempt employees and Paid Time Off (PTO) for non‑exempt employees
  • Paid holidays
  • Life insurance and short‑term and long‑term disability coverage
Benefit offerings, eligibility, and required employer contributions may vary based on role, classification, and applicable federal, state, and local laws, including those tied to an employee’s primary work location.
Where required by law, the Company provides paid sick leave, paid family and parental leave, and other mandated benefits in accordance with applicable state and local requirements.
Diversity and Inclusion
Davies is dedicated to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace that embraces a wide range of perspectives and experiences. We believe that diversity of thought is essential for innovation and creativity, and we actively promote an environment where all voices are valued and heard.

Compensation Transparency:
The salary range listed reflects the full compensation band for this role across all locations. Actual compensation will be based on factors such as skills, experience, qualifications, and geographic location, which may impact the final offer. We share ranges to remain transparent and consistent with pay equity practices.

Background Check & Fair Chance Compliance
Any background check or review of criminal history, if applicable to the role, will be conducted only after a conditional offer of employment and in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws, including fair‑chance hiring requirements.

Massachusetts NoticeIt is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

We do not use sites like Facebook, Craigslist, or Telegram to recruit or interview potential employees or contractors. If you have been asked to provide any information through any method other than our career portal, please email us at recruitment@davies-group.com

raw.title: Customer Success Specialist
raw.excerpt: About Edged Data Centers Edged is a fast-growing provider of sustainable data centers and energy infrastructure.
raw.description:
About Edged Data Centers Edged is a fast-growing provider of sustainable data centers and energy infrastructure. The company builds and operates a global network of ultra-efficient, AI-ready data centers with waterless cooling for colocation, hyperscale and build-to-suit customers. The highly differentiated infrastructure platform is the first large-scale, global deployment of waterless cooling platform-wide and transforms data center growth into a catalyst for sustainable development. Edged is backed by a deep proprietary technology stack that will include renewable microgrid systems, ultra-clean generators, and waste-to-fuel solutions. The platform is designed for rapid deployment with more than a dozen new data centers operating or under construction across Europe and North America and a gigawatt-scale project pipeline. The North American division of Edged is a joint venture between one of the largest private multinational corporations in the world and an affiliate of Endeavour. Endeavour is a purpose-driven organization helping innovators to develop and launch breakthrough solutions for global challenges in the areas of energy, water, and waste. Endeavour companies are made up of passionate change-makers who want to leave the world better than the way we found it. Today, Endeavour is deploying solutions that are immediately scalable and deliver both high financial returns and positive impact, including EV charging, waterless data center cooling, and advanced energy systems.

Opportunity Edged is seeking a dynamic Customer Success Specialist as the primary point of contact to manage customer relationships, services, and overall customer experience. The role will be a vital member of the sales team of the North American division of Edged Data Centers working with Sales and Operations. The Customer Success Specialist is expected to work independently on customer onboarding, complex projects, and support any issues that arise. Responsibilities include the ongoing management of the customer success program, customer reports and continuous improvement of customer portal. The Customer Success Specialist needs to be an agile, team-focused individual, with proven professionalism, who is comfortable in a rapidly changing environment. The right person is trustworthy with confidential information, highly organized, self-motivated, has excellent communication skills, can think strategically, and works equally as well independently as with a team. Edged strives to maintain smooth operations and achieves this by empowering our people, by providing autonomy and flexibility in the way we work, by developing a habit of constant, open communication, and by creating a culture of excellence, appreciation, trust, and respect.

Key Responsibilities

Include but not limited to:

  • Customer Success Specialist drives collaboration with client and internal cross functional teams to manage client implementations and meet client requirements timely and efficiently.
  • Project management and implementation oversight from customer order acceptance through provision of service.
  • Develop strategies to grow customers through successful customer experience.
  • Drive data analytics, metrics, and interpretation of a mission critical environment to identify inefficiencies, opportunities, exceptions, and correlations, and proactively respond before they impact the business and its customers.
  • MBR and QBR draft and review with customers.
  • Deliver support and service solutions for customers in line with industry best practice.
  • Monitor the effectiveness of the service against SLA/KPI’s, drive through change as needed to deliver continual service improvement.
  • Coordinate and manage any customer audits including follow up corrective actions.
  • Identify and implement change within the team to ensure it can take on new service offerings.
  • Contribute proactively to new service development.
  • Ensure quality and up-to-date documentation exists for all service arrangements.
  • Achieve consistent customer satisfaction ratings and respond appropriately to customer feedback on areas for improvement.
  • Take responsibility for customer escalations and act as a point of escalation both in and out of hours as required
  • Drive a continual service improvement schedule based on a desire to become a world class managed service provider.
  • Prepare Sales Orders and accompanying exhibits for Customer Intake
  • Delivery of project requests
  • Provide training schedule to support implementation and operations for clients
  • Implement reviews and audits to ensure consistent implementation standards and identification of areas requiring improvement.
  • Implement and drive a “lessons learned” method.
  • Coordinate escalation matrix for new clients and update accordingly
  • Be the “voice of the customer” internally and work to consistently improve the customer experience
  • Coordinate, collect and analyze customer experience surveys. Drive for improvements based on feedback gained
  • Work cross functionally to deliver quarterly summaries for customers across multiple lines of business
  • Provide training to customers on portal functionality
  • Coordinate with Incident Manager and Operations team on customer communications and notifications
  • Partner with Sales and Service Delivery to ensure accuracy and timely delivery of proposals

Skills and Requirements Education / Experience

  • Bachelor’s Degree
  • Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in data centers customer support/success, Sales and or operations.
  • Excellent customer management skills.
  • Experience in large-scale planning and coordination, with experience delivering multiple concurrent projects on tight timelines.
  • A solid understanding of enterprise level infrastructure and services.
  • Knowledge of data center infrastructure, including HVAC, electrical and security systems.
  • Requires advanced analytical and quantitative skills.
  • Familiarity with industry standards and best practices, such as ITIL, ISO 27001, uptime institute guidelines and SOC II.
  • Project or program management experience and certification(s) (e.g. Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, PMI, Agile...)
  • MSOffice applications. i.e., Excel, Outlook, Word, and PowerPoint.
  • A solid understanding of financial management, budgeting, and forecasting
  • ITIL certification is a plus.

Specific Skills / Abilities

  • Strong written and oral communication skills.
  • Process and workflow development.
  • Excellent problem-solving and decision-making abilities while working in ambiguous situations.
  • Ability to develop operational standards and project tracking/management documents.
  • Understanding of IT infrastructure, including servers, storage, networking, and remote hands.
  • Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities.
  • Ability to analyze and solve problems involving several options with limited information.
  • Demonstrated success managing customers.
  • Ability to travel as needed but expected up to 25% of the time.

Pay Type: Salaried FTE: Full-Time Dept: Sales & Marketing Reports to: Customer Success Manager

EEO Statement:

Edged is an equal opportunities employer. We believe in ensuring equal access to employment opportunities for all. We assess candidate qualifications and make recruiting decisions based on the experience, capabilities and skills you share with us in your application and applicable materials. Hiring and employment decisions within Edged are not based on religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Total Rewards Statement:

This role is also eligible for a competitive benefits package that includes: medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; 401(k) retirement plan; flexible spending and HSA accounts; paid holidays; PTO; employee assistance program; and other company benefits. Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including your qualifications, location, skills, competencies, and experience and may fall outside of the range shown.

Great Place to Work Enjoy…

  • A fast-paced, entrepreneurial culture focused on innovation.
  • A flexible, autonomous work environment.
  • A culture of respect, learning, and excellence.
  • Experienced, highly talented experts as team peers.
  • Growth and travel opportunities.
  • A team of change-makers having a significant impact on people and the planet.

Contact: edcrecruiting@edged.us

About Us:

Datacor is the leading provider of software solutions, including ERP, CRM, Asset Tracking, Simulation and Formulation, to the process manufacturing space. We are on a mission to better equip the industry with software solutions and move it forward by building thoughtful, intuitive products that solve our customers’ most difficult problems.

We are passionate about serving our customers and helping them use data as a competitive advantage. Our customers make products that extend and sustain lives by sanitizing, fertilizing, beautifying, cleaning, and recycling the world we live in. We at Datacor help our customers make those products you use every day more safely, cost effectively and more efficiently through our technology platforms and applications.

About Us:

Datacor is the leading provider of software solutions, including ERP, CRM, Asset Tracking, Simulation and Formulation, to the process manufacturing space. We are on a mission to better equip the industry with software solutions and move it forward by building thoughtful, intuitive products that solve our customers’ most difficult problems.

We are passionate about serving our customers and helping them use data as a competitive advantage. Our customers make products that extend and sustain lives by sanitizing, fertilizing, beautifying, cleaning, and recycling the world we live in. We at Datacor help our customers make those products you use every day more safely, cost effectively and more efficiently through our technology platforms and applications.

We’re looking for a Senior Technical Writer who thrives in complex domains and enjoys turning technical detail into clear, accurate, user-focused documentation.

If you're a self-starter who manages projects independently and sees documentation as a service that enhances both the customer experience and internal collaboration, we’d love to hear from you.

What You’ll Do:

  • Work independently with minimal direction, demonstrating ownership of documentation projects and the ability to drive results without close supervision.
  • Create, organize, and maintain user-facing and internal documentation including user guides, release notes, process documents, and additional documentation as needed.
  • Collaborate with product managers, engineers, QA, and other stakeholders to gather technical information and validate accuracy.
  • Work in a cloud-based Component Content Management System (CCMS) to ensure content reuse, consistency, collaboration, and scalability.
  • Advocate for users by crafting content that is clear, useable, and aligned with product workflows.
  • Build strong working relationships across teams (product, support, and engineering) and contribute to a positive, service-focused documentation culture.
  • Leverage AI tools to accelerate delivery; for example, transforming recorded demos and transcripts into draft documentation for rapid editing and refinement.
  • Use AI-powered editing and analysis tools to improve documentation accuracy, consistency, and overall quality.
  • Apply AI-based analytics and reporting to gain visibility into the questions users are asking and the issues they’re trying to solve, helping the team identify content gaps and opportunities for improvement.
  • Improve content, processes, and standards based on feedback, analytics, and your own observations.

Qualifications:

  • 5 to 7+ years of technical writing experience documenting enterprise-level software applications.
  • Proven ability to manage your own projects and deadlines with minimal oversight.
  • Experience using topic-based CCMS authoring tools (e.g., ClickHelp, MadCap Flare, etc.).
  • Strong collaboration skills: you work well with engineers, project managers, and peers.
  • Excellent writing, grammar, editing, and content structuring skills.
  • Comfort working in a remote environment and across time zones.
  • Professional, courteous, and relationship-driven approach to teamwork.
  • Demonstrates a customer-service mindset toward both internal stakeholders and the external users of our applications and documentation.
  • You treat documentation as a critical business service, not an afterthought.
  • Proven experience leveraging AI to enhance documentation efficiency, consistency, and insight, along with an enthusiastic and forward-thinking attitude toward emerging AI technologies.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Technical Communication, English, or a related field.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience documenting integrated enterprise platforms involving the process manufacturing, chemical distribution, and engineering industries.
  • Familiarity with collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, and GitHub.
  • Experience creating API documentation.

EOE Statement:

Datacor is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis or race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

Use of AI During Interviews:

At Datacor, we value thoughtful problem-solving and authentic perspectives. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation process, we ask that candidates do not use generative AI tools or outside assistance during live interviews unless explicitly stated otherwise. We're interested in hearing your experience, your approach, and how you think through challenges.

raw.description:
Job Summary:
The Payroll Accountant III is responsible for ensuring the accuracy and compliance of payroll-related financial processes. This includes preparing and maintaining payroll account reconciliations, supporting month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close activities, and providing support for internal and external audits. The Payroll Accountant will also identify opportunities for process improvements, maintain compliance records, and provide subject matter expertise on key financial/accounting matters.

Essential Functions:

  • Prepare and maintain payroll-related account reconciliations including payroll tax accounts and investigate and resolve discrepancies between payroll system records and tax filings.
  • Prepare and support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close activities by preparing and ensuring all adjusting and accrual journal entries and entered and posted.
  • Support internal and external audits by providing payroll documentation, reconcile and validate data, sampling and testing, and analysis.
  • Identify, recommend and implement quality and productivity improvements.Document tax processes and maintain compliance records for regulatory and audit purposes.Maintain standard operating procedures.
  • Provide subject matter expertise or recurring and ad hoc reports and analysis on key financial/accounting matters to appropriate leaders and/or areas within the organization.

  • Maintain accurate tax jurisdiction setup in payroll systems to ensure proper withholding and register for state and local tax accounts.

  • Apply knowledge of the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) to accurately calculate employee compensation, including gross-to-net pay, pre-tax and post-tax benefits, and their impact on taxable wages.
  • Research and resolve payroll tax notices from government agencies and state/local taxing authorities (IRS, Department of Revenue, etc.).
  • Support quarter-end and year-end payroll tax reporting including W-2 preparation and reconciliation of quarter-to-date and year-to-date payroll wages, taxes, and deductions in the payroll system and ensure totals reconcile with general ledger payroll accounts.

Required Experience:

4+ years related work experience.

Related Bachelor's degree required Accounting or Finance

Strong oral and written communication skills

Proficient in Excel

Experience with General Ledger ERP systems

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience with Oracle HCM and ADP

FPC or CPP Certification Preferred

General Physical Demands:
Sedentary work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally to move objects. Jobs are sedentary if traversing activities are required only occasionally.


What We Offer:
As a Florida Blue employee, you will thrive in our Be Well, Work Well, GuideWell culture where being well as an individual, and working well as a team, are both important in serving our members and communities.

To support your wellbeing, comprehensive benefits are offered. As an employee, you will have access to:

  • Medical, dental, vision, life and global travel health insurance;
  • Income protection benefits: life insurance, short- and long-term disability programs;
  • Leave programs to support personal circumstances;
  • Retirement Savings Plan including employer match;
  • Paid time off, volunteer time off, 10 holidays and 2 well-being days;
  • Additional voluntary benefits available; and
  • A comprehensive wellness program

Employee benefits are designed to align with federal and state employment laws. Benefits may vary based on the state in which work is performed. Benefits for intern, part-time and seasonal employees may differ.

To support your financial wellbeing, we offer competitive pay as well as opportunities for incentive or commission compensation. We also conduct regular annual reviews with pay for performance considerations for base pay increases.

Annualized Salary Range: $71,200 - $115,700

Typical Annualized Hiring Range: $71,200 - $89,000

Final pay will be determined with consideration of market competitiveness, internal equity, and the job-related knowledge, skills, training, and experience you bring.

We are an Equal Employment Opportunity employer committed to cultivating a work experience where everyone feels like they belong and can perform at their best in pursuit of our mission. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment.

Job Summary:
The Payroll Accountant III is responsible for ensuring the accuracy and compliance of payroll-related financial processes. This includes preparing and maintaining payroll account reconciliations, supporting month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close activities, and providing support for internal and external audits. The Payroll Accountant will also identify opportunities for process improvements, maintain compliance records, and provide subject matter expertise on key financial/accounting matters.

Essential Functions:

  • Prepare and maintain payroll-related account reconciliations including payroll tax accounts and investigate and resolve discrepancies between payroll system records and tax filings.
  • Prepare and support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close activities by preparing and ensuring all adjusting and accrual journal entries and entered and posted.
  • Support internal and external audits by providing payroll documentation, reconcile and validate data, sampling and testing, and analysis.
  • Identify, recommend and implement quality and productivity improvements.Document tax processes and maintain compliance records for regulatory and audit purposes.Maintain standard operating procedures.
  • Provide subject matter expertise or recurring and ad hoc reports and analysis on key financial/accounting matters to appropriate leaders and/or areas within the organization.

  • Maintain accurate tax jurisdiction setup in payroll systems to ensure proper withholding and register for state and local tax accounts.

  • Apply knowledge of the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) to accurately calculate employee compensation, including gross-to-net pay, pre-tax and post-tax benefits, and their impact on taxable wages.
  • Research and resolve payroll tax notices from government agencies and state/local taxing authorities (IRS, Department of Revenue, etc.).
  • Support quarter-end and year-end payroll tax reporting including W-2 preparation and reconciliation of quarter-to-date and year-to-date payroll wages, taxes, and deductions in the payroll system and ensure totals reconcile with general ledger payroll accounts.

Required Experience:

4+ years related work experience.

Related Bachelor's degree required Accounting or Finance

Strong oral and written communication skills

Proficient in Excel

Experience with General Ledger ERP systems

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience with Oracle HCM and ADP

FPC or CPP Certification Preferred

General Physical Demands:
Sedentary work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally to move objects. Jobs are sedentary if traversing activities are required only occasionally.


What We Offer:
As a Florida Blue employee, you will thrive in our Be Well, Work Well, GuideWell culture where being well as an individual, and working well as a team, are both important in serving our members and communities.

To support your wellbeing, comprehensive benefits are offered. As an employee, you will have access to:

  • Medical, dental, vision, life and global travel health insurance;
  • Income protection benefits: life insurance, short- and long-term disability programs;
  • Leave programs to support personal circumstances;
  • Retirement Savings Plan including employer match;
  • Paid time off, volunteer time off, 10 holidays and 2 well-being days;
  • Additional voluntary benefits available; and
  • A comprehensive wellness program

Employee benefits are designed to align with federal and state employment laws. Benefits may vary based on the state in which work is performed. Benefits for intern, part-time and seasonal employees may differ.

To support your financial wellbeing, we offer competitive pay as well as opportunities for incentive or commission compensation. We also conduct regular annual reviews with pay for performance considerations for base pay increases.

Typical Annualized Hiring Range: $71,200 - $89,000

Our client is a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Patient Care space with a large presence in the Home Medical Equipment (HME) and Durable Medical Equipment (DME) niche. They are seeking a highly experienced professional to fill an immediate full-time remote Senior Product Designer/Industrial Designer opening.

As the Senior Product Designer/Industrial Designer, you will lead the design and development of next-generation patient care products - from concept through production - translating caregiver feedback, customer reviews, and competitive insights into profitable, manufacturable solutions with exceptional ergonomics, usability, and functional detail.

About the company:

The company is a purpose-driven provider of Patient Care products dedicated to enhancing the lives of patients and caregivers. With thousands of positive reviews and a passionate, diverse team from around the globe, the company prides itself on creating products that are not only well-designed but genuinely useful. Customer obsession is a guiding principle that shapes the company's strategy, culture, and decisions.

The company's mission is centered on improving well-being through meticulous attention to detail and continuous listening to customer feedback, ensuring that its solutions meet real caregiving needs. Its vision is to empower patients and caregivers with innovative products that improve quality of life. The company also values caring customer service, professional growth, work-life balance, and a supportive environment where team members can thrive and contribute to meaningful product impact.

This is a Full-Time | Fully Remote position reporting to the Project Manager.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the end-to-end design process from concept development to production-ready solutions, ensuring all designs go through rigorous DFM (Design for Manufacturing) and DFA (Design for Assembly) analysis.
  • Translate internal product briefs, caregiver feedback, VOC data, and customer reviews into innovative, user-centered product concepts.
  • Apply deep materials knowledge to select the most suitable materials that balance aesthetic with structural durability and cost-efficiency.
  • Create advanced CAD models and detailed technical design and engineering documentation, utilizing FEA (Finite Element Analysis) and structural simulations to validate mechanical integrity and performance before prototyping.
  • Design and validate mockups, prototypes, and functional test samples.
  • Collaborate closely with engineers, sourcing partners, and marketing to balance creativity with cost targets, supplier capabilities, and timelines.
  • Optimize design-to-prototype cycle times and improve design efficiency.
  • Maintain high standards of manufacturability, functional performance, and customer satisfaction (targeting 4.5+ product ratings).
  • Communicate effectively with international manufacturing partners, including Asian/China suppliers.

Expected Outcomes:

  • Deliver 4–6 fully engineered, manufacturable product designs within the first 3 months.
  • Develop final production-ready samples of 12–18 new SKUs by the end of 2026.
  • Achieve 30% contribution margin in design cost modeling.
  • Optimize and meet quarterly design-to-prototype cycle time targets within the first 6 months.
  • Implement a structured, user-driven design process for top legacy products within 12 months.
  • Establish and maintain a repeatable, scalable design documentation system.

Qualifications:

    • 3+ years of experience in Industrial Design or Product Design.
    • 2+ years designing mass-produced consumer, HME, or DME (patient care) products.
    • Experience taking products from concept to mass production.
    • Experience in mechanical design, prototyping, simulation, and testing.
    • Experience working within manufacturing and supplier constraints.
    • Experience communicating and collaborating with Asian/Chinese manufacturers.
    • Experience designing products for marketplaces influenced by public customer reviews.
    • Experience with mechanical CAD software, such as SolidWorks, Inventor, Onshape.
    • Experience with cost modeling and margin-focused design decisions.
    • Strong analytical skills with the ability to structure qualitative and quantitative insights into actionable design improvements.
    • Deep understanding of ergonomics, usability, and user-centered design principles.
    • Close attention to detail and commitment to excellence.
    • Proactive problem-solver with a strong ownership mindset.
    • Excellent cross-functional collaboration and communication skills.
    • High adaptability and ability to thrive in a fast-scaling environment.

Core Competencies & Values:

  • Attention to Detail – Nothing slips through the cracks.
  • Commitment & Work Ethic – Willingness to go the distance to get results.
  • Consistency & Persistence – Demonstrates tenacity in achieving goals.
  • Strategic Thinking & Growth Mindset – Sees and communicates the bigger picture.
  • Proactive Problem Solving – Brings new ideas without being prompted.
  • Integrity & Trustworthiness – Operates with honesty and transparency.
  • Customer Obsession – Actively integrates customer feedback into product improvements.
  • Creativity & Innovation – Develops original, differentiated solutions.
  • High Standards – Expects excellence from self and team.
  • Teamwork & Cross-Functional Collaboration – Works seamlessly across departments.
  • Analytical Thinking – Transforms data into informed design decisions.
  • Flexibility & Adaptability – Thrives in dynamic and evolving conditions.

What We Offer:

  • Full-time remote position in a rapidly growing international company.
  • Opportunity to design next-generation patient care products with meaningful market impact.
  • Direct influence on revenue growth and product innovation strategy.
  • High ownership and autonomy in decision-making.
  • A performance-driven, values-based culture.
  • Competitive compensation based on experience.
  • Annual fully sponsored Company Trips.
  • Quarterly Rock Bonus.
  • Performance Bonus.
  • Paid Time Off: Local public holidays plus two weeks of paid vacation annually.
  • Long-term growth opportunities aligned with company expansion.

This is a unique opportunity for a senior-level designer who combines creativity with engineering discipline, strategic thinking with hands-on execution, and customer empathy with commercial awareness.

About the role of Clinical Review Specialist

As a Clinical Review Specialist for Premera, you will be responsible for conducting detailed clinical and coding evaluations to ensure claim payments are accurate and aligned with Premera policies and industry coding and billing standards. Using advanced coding expertise and your previous clinical experience, you will review medical records and appeal submissions to assess coding accuracy. The Clinical Review Specialist requires strong clinical judgment, coding proficiency, critical thinking, and the ability to identify discrepancies between billed services and the documented care. You will collaborate with internal teams and external stakeholders to promote consistency and accuracy in claim outcomes, while contributing to ongoing improvements in review processes and quality standards.

What you’ll do:

  • Serve as a subject matter expert for claim payment accuracy including pre-payment claim editing, pre-payment claims auditing, contract compliance, post-payment payment integrity solutions, etc.
  • Coordinate with vendors and internal teams to design, propose, implement, prioritize, and oversee payment integrity solutions that increase claim payment accuracy.
  • Collect, analyze, synthesize, and interpret multiple sources of quantitative and qualitative data. Extract key insights to draw conclusions and prepare recommendations to make strategic and operational decisions.
  • Proficiency with payment integrity tools, such as but not limited to, Optum CES, ClaimXTen, and Pareo.
  • Lead technology/tool updates, testing, and troubleshooting with internal IT teams and external vendors.
  • Effectively respond to payment integrity inquiries from providers, internal teams, appeals, and vendors.
  • Manage scope of multiple projects or audits with minimal direction and supervision.
  • Collaborate with appropriate departments regarding payment integrity issues identified during editing or auditing processes.
  • Develop and facilitate presentations by analyzing and interpreting data to communicate business issues, findings, and recommendations.

What you’ll bring:

  • Bachelor's Degree or (4) years of work experience. (Required)
  • (4) years of analytical experience in a technical, healthcare, or business-related discipline, including (2) years of experience leading small to medium size projects. (Required)
  • Comprehensive knowledge of CPT, ICD10, HCPCS or other coding structures. (Required)
  • Current State Licensure as a Registered (RN) or Licensed Practical (LPN) Nurse where licensing is required by state law. (Strongly preferred)
  • (4) years of experience with healthcare claims processing systems or provider billing and revenue cycle management systems. (Preferred)
  • Certified Professional Coder designation. (Preferred)
  • Certified Internal Auditor. (Preferred)
  • Previous Payor experience. (Preferred)
  • Certified as a Six Sigma or Lean leader. (Preferred)
  • Experience with various querying tools, including MS SQL Server, SAS. (Preferred)
  • Experience with claim editing tools, configurations, updates, and troubleshooting. (Preferred)
  • Demonstrated advanced skills in Microsoft Office Suite: Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint. (Preferred)

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Ability to establish and maintain positive and effective work relationships with internal staff, external vendors, and state and federal agencies.
  • Demonstrated project management experience.
  • Exceptional analytical skills - demonstrated ability to ensure reliability and relevance of data collected.
  • Excellent written communication skills - demonstrated ability to compose sensitive, non-routine correspondence requiring tact and diplomacy.
  • Excellent speaking and presentation skills - demonstrated ability to deliver presentations regarding controversial issues, ability to deliver talks and/or speeches before groups and audiences.
  • Exceptional problem-solving skills - demonstrated ability to solve a wide range of highly complex, multi-disciplinary problems, which must consider long-term company-wide planning.

At Nebius Academy we're building a hands-on online course for experienced mobile developers on the practical use of Cursor and other AI coding tools in professional mobile development workflows.

As the Instructor, you will lead interactive live sessions that go beyond passive learning — empowering engineers to apply AI tools critically and effectively in real-world mobile development contexts.

Your audience will be B2B clients: skilled Android or iOS developers working in fast-paced engineering environments and looking to improve productivity, code quality, and development speed through AI-assisted workflows.

We are looking for instructors with strong hands-on expertise in Golang or Android, or iOS development. Experience across more than one of these areas is a plus, but not required.

You’ll collaborate with the course team to design, facilitate, and iterate on expert-led live sessions delivered over several weeks.

  • Prepare practical workshop scenarios and training materials for materials for Golang or Android or iOS developers using Cursor and other AI coding tools, in collaboration with our Instructional Designer.

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong hands-on expertise in Golang or Android or iOS development.
  • Practical experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar platforms in real development workflows.
  • Strong understanding of mobile development workflows, app architecture, testing strategies, debugging, performance, and developer tooling.
  • Ability to explain how AI coding tools work, including their strengths, limitations, and AI-related risks.

Nice to have

Tech-savvy Paralegal with a passion for customer service

Join Codekeeper and take a pivotal role in driving customer success for our clients. As a LegalTech company, we operate at the intersection of legal drafting and review, customer communications, and technical support. We are searching for a talented Paralegal who is passionate about delivering exceptional customer service and thrives in a dynamic, multifaceted role.

Applications are open for the next two months, and we will hire the right candidate as soon as we find the perfect fit.


Role Description

As a Tech-savvy Paralegal within the Customer Success team, this role is pivotal in ensuring customers attain their desired outcomes using our product or service. This responsibility is crucial for enhancing customer satisfaction and retention. You will act as an essential bridge between our company and its customers, championing customer success and satisfaction. Additionally, the duties shall include conducting legal research, drafting legal documents, and offering support on legal matters, contributing significantly to our overall service quality.


Key Responsibilities

Legal Drafting/Review

  • As part of our service customers require written agreements incorporating their requirements. You’ll be managing this process by drafting the legal language to fit those requirements

  • You’ll be preparing the required documents, which will then be checked by your manager before it is shared with the client

Customer Service

  • You’ll be receiving requests from users and leads, asking questions about the services we offer and how to manage their Codekeeper account

  • Since we operate a full service model, you’ll be making sure their requests are handled quickly and correctly

Tech Setup Support

  • Customers will also be required to set up connections between their source code management platform

  • You will support them in this process and make sure everything is administered correctly on our side

Sales Support

  • Since in our view customer success starts from the very first contact, you’ll also be working with leads who have questions, guiding them about our service

  • This is done via email and website chat

Report Drafting

  • Some of our customers require us to inspect information they provide

  • You draft the reports and send them back to them


About the Company

Codekeeper was founded by tech industry professionals to revolutionize software escrow for the cloud era. We offer state-of-the-art software escrow solutions that mitigate third-party risks in business operations. As a remote-first company with a central office in The Hague, we prioritize a healthy, resilient organization to support the development of our app.
🌐 codekeeper.co/


What We Offer

  • Passionate and fun-loving colleagues

  • Startup mindset with ample opportunities for growth

  • Regular team activities and gatherings

  • Comprehensive onboarding process with a dedicated ramp-up period

  • A supportive team that values open communication and direct feedback

  • A chance to excel in your career and make a difference


What We Are Looking For

We are seeking a motivated individual ready to embrace this challenge. While extensive legal or technical experience is not expected, familiarity with LegalTech concepts is crucial for success in this role.

  • Prior experience in customer success or similar role is preferred

  • Proficiency in drafting legal documents

  • Exposure to working with diverse companies of varying sizes and industries


Additional Requirements

  • Analytical thinking, and a proactive attitude

  • Excellent written English communication skills

  • Proficiency in modern web tools like Google Docs and similar platforms

  • Highly organized with a strong attention to detail

  • Comfortable adapting and multitasking in a fast-paced environment


Additional Info

  • Job Location: Remote

  • Join us to shape the future of software escrow!


How to Apply

Please send an application that speaks directly to how you would like to fill this position. There are no right answers or expectations. Show us your role in our company’s future and our role in yours. Address some of the work we do. Introduce yourself as a colleague. Feel free to respond in either Dutch or English.

About Academy of the Digital Industries

Všechno začalo docela jednoduše: hledali jsme lidi s těmi správnými digitálními dovednostmi, nemohli jsme je najít, tak jsme si řekli – výborně, vyškolíme si je sami.

Z toho malého projektu v Tbilisi v roce 2018 vyrostla globální Edtech platforma s více než 30 000 absolventy.

Naše programy tvoří lidé z praxe. Vycházejí z toho, co firmy opravdu potřebují. A učíme v prostředí, kde se spolupracuje, ptá se a roste.

V roce 2023 jsme se dali dohromady sTetherem, abychom to, co děláme, posunuli dál – za hranice, k lidem po celém světě, kteří chtějí vzdělávání, které je skutečně posune.

Dnes připravujeme novou generaci digitálních profesionálů: marketéry, designéry, programátory, tvůrce. Lidi, kteří nechtějí jen práci, ale chtějí něco měnit. Držíme se hodnot, kterými opravdu žijeme: lidé jsou na prvním místě, zůstáváme zvědaví, děláme skvělou práci a bereme za ni odpovědnost. A teď to teprve začíná.

Lead máme. Zájem máme. Teď potřebujeme někoho, kdo to umí dotáhnout.

Hledáme zkušeného closera, který dokáže ty, co zvažují změnu, dovést k samotnému rozhodnutí investovat do sebe samých.

Tahle role není o „péči o zákazníka“. Je to role s jasnou orientací na výsledky revenue, konverze a počet zapsaných studentů. Jde tu o tah na branku, práci s rozhodováním a uzavírání obchodů.

Co budeš dělat

Budeš mluvit s lidmi, kteří už o změně přemýšlí – chtějí novou kariéru, lepší skillset, posun v životě.

Tvůj úkol?

  • Pomoci jim přestat váhat a udělat konkrétní krok – koupit si kurz

  • Povedeš celý proces od prvního callu až po zaplacení

  • Budeš pracovat s inboundem, outboundem i vlastní pipeline

  • Budeš řídit tempo, ne čekat

  • Poradíš si s námitkami (cena, čas, důvěra, konkurence) denodenně

  • Tady se nehraje na „ozvi se, až budeš ready“

  • Tady se rozhodnutí dělají teď a s tebou

Requirements

Co od tebe potřebujeme

  • Min. 3 roky v B2C sales, kde jsi nesl/a target

  • Zkušenost s prodejem vzdělávání nebo služeb, kde se zákazník rozmýšlí

  • Reálné výsledky – ne pocit, ale čísla

  • Schopnost jet samostatně a neztrácet tempo

  • Rozumíš tomu, jak přemýšlí český zákazník.

  • Umíš prodat hodnotu, ne cenu.

  • A když přijde námitka, víš, že to není konec, ale začátek práce.

Tohle není pro tebe, pokud:

  • Čekáš, až se zákazník rozhodne sám

  • Potřebuješ skripty na každou větu

  • Prodáváš hlavně slevou

  • Máš zkušenosti spíš z B2B než z přímého prodeje lidem

Co za to

  • Remote spolupráce

  • Velká míra svobody

  • Přístup ke všem našim kurzům + benefity pro rodinu

  • Referral program

  • Paid Time Off

  • Tým, kde se maká – ale zároveň drží při sobě

Gartner analysts are industry thought leaders who create must-have insight and provide advice to a broad range of world-leading organizations. If working on the SELT service anywhere in the world (outside of the UK) personnel will undergo background checks that are equivalent to those stated for the UK.
