Our world class sales and sales support teams work directly with businesses of all sizes to offer products and services to meet our customers’ unique needs. We are committed to understanding our customers and use best-in-class sales tools and technology to find the best solutions. We’re constantly discovering new ways to reach our goals, taking time to develop our skills, and investing in our career growth, so we can enjoy lucrative opportunities and grow our careers both within and beyond sales.

The Strategic Account Executive (SAE) is responsible for driving profitable growth through the execution, adoption, and expansion of strategic programs for large Integrated Delivery Networks (IDNs) and enterprise healthcare accounts operating under established Group Purchasing Organization (GPO) agreements.

The role is focused on account-specific execution and performance management, supporting GPO-, IDN- , and account-level initiatives rather than enterprise-wide GPO ownership, while ensuring programs are effectively implemented, adopted, and scaled across divisions and facilities. The SAE partners closely with Strategic Account Directors, Print Account Executives, Analysts, Pricing, and Category teams to drive successful implementation, sales ramp, and ongoing optimization of programs across IDNs. The SAE is accountable for account-level program performance, including identifying opportunities to expand adoption, improve standardization, and grow print share of wallet within assigned accounts.

In addition, the SAE supports and leads Annual Business Reviews (ABRs), Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), and other customer-required business reviews, providing insights and analysis to drive standardization, consolidation, and long-term account growth. This role requires strong cross-functional collaboration to translate strategic agreements into realized revenue and sustained customer value.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Establishes and maintains business relationships with executive and operational leadership within assigned Integrated Delivery Networks (IDNs), divisions, and enterprise healthcare accounts which may be operating under GPO agreements
  • Supports account-level negotiations and program discussions with VP- and Director-level stakeholders for complex healthcare IDNs and enterprise accounts, operating within established GPO, pricing, and contract frameworks as required
  • Navigates complex sales and program execution cycles involving multiple stakeholders and decision-makers to ensure successful rollout, adoption, and sales ramp of approved initiatives
  • Demonstrates expertise in healthcare buying processes and supports product selection, eCommerce and integrated solutions, and standardization and consolidation initiatives to drive operational efficiency and cost reduction for customers
  • Provides guidance, standards, and execution support to Print Account Executives, Account Managers, and supporting teams to ensure consistent deployment, adoption, and growth of strategic programs within assigned accounts
  • Partners closely with category experts to deliver account-specific insights, solutions, and value propositions that support program expansion and customer objectives
  • Collaborates with internal resources including Strategic Account Directors, Analysts, Pricing, Category Leadership, Implementation teams, and sales partners to meet customer needs and drive profitable growth within assigned accounts
  • Applies strong business acumen and consultative selling methodologies to align program execution with customer priorities and initiatives such as integrations, sustainability efforts, and vendor consolidation strategies

Impact on Business

  • Responsible for managing sales and profitability of $7–15M annually within assigned Integrated Delivery Networks (IDNs) and enterprise healthcare accounts
  • Drives incremental growth of $2.5M–$4M annually through program adoption, expansion, and increased print share of wallet within assigned accounts

Business Strategy

  • Contributes to business strategy through execution and optimization of approved healthcare strategic account initiatives, supporting Print growth objectives within assigned Integrated Delivery Networks (IDNs) and enterprise healthcare accounts
  • Executes Print objectives by aligning account-level programs to established GPO, IDN, and aggregation group strategies, driving profitable growth through adoption, expansion, and standardization at the account and division level
  • Develops and maintains strategic account execution plans for assigned IDNs and enterprise accounts, collaborating with Strategic Account Directors, category teams, and internal partners to grow print share of wallet, expand existing programs, and support customer retention and growth
  • Works closely with Business Development teams, Implementations, Analysts, Pricing, and Print Account Executives to ensure successful ramp of new business, achievement of adoption milestones, and delivery of incremental revenue within assigned account

Innovation and Change

  • Integrates feedback from Group Purchasing Organizations (GPOs) and customer leadership into account strategies and deploys aligned initiatives across internal sales and support teams
  • Monitors business, industry, and market trends to inform program execution strategies and identify opportunities for improvement within assigned accounts
  • Identifies and develops strategic account program enhancements that strengthen customer relationships, improve adoption, and support growth objectives
  • Leads the development and execution of internal communication and enablement efforts to ensure alignment across cross-functional teams supporting assigned accounts
  • Partners with internal stakeholders to deploy the appropriate resources and capabilities needed to achieve objectives outlined in customer agreements
  • Ensures effective processes are in place to support consistent program execution, performance tracking, and continuous improvement

Discretion and Independent Judgement

  • Exercises independent judgment in prioritizing account-level initiatives, sequencing program rollouts, and allocating effort to maximize adoption, sales ramp, and customer impact within assigned Integrated Delivery Networks (IDNs)
  • Makes execution-level decisions related to program optimization, account standardization opportunities, and growth tactics within established GPO agreements, pricing guidelines, and contractual frameworks
  • Identifies risks, performance gaps, and expansion opportunities within assigned accounts, determining appropriate actions or escalation to Strategic Account Directors and leadership as needed

Communications and Interactions

  • Communicates regularly with IDN, division, and account-level stakeholders, including executive and operational leadership, to align on program execution, performance, adoption progress, and growth opportunities within assigned accounts
  • Translates customer feedback, performance results, and operational insights into clear, actionable communication for internal partners, including Strategic Account Directors, Print Account Executives, Analysts, Pricing, Category, and Implementation teams
  • Prepares and delivers structured account communications, including updates, presentations, and materials for Annual Business Reviews (ABRs), Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), and other customer-required forums
  • Maintains ongoing communication with cross-functional internal teams to ensure clarity on priorities, execution plans, risks, and timelines, supporting consistent delivery of customer agreements and program objectives

What You Bring to the Table

  • Strong results orientation with a drive to achieve and exceed performance objectives
  • Demonstrates a continuous improvement mindset with a low tolerance for complacency
  • Proven ability to learn from challenges and apply insights to improve outcomes and drive forward progress
  • Experience and a proven track record of managing complex programs or driving business development within large accounts
  • Ability to effectively engage and communicate with senior-level stakeholders
  • Strong presentation skills, with the ability to deliver compelling messaging in both virtual and inperson settings
  • Expertise in consultative, solutions, and insight-based selling, along with strong negotiation and advanced client management skills
  • Ability to develop and execute strategic customer growth plans in partnership with product category and cross-functional teams
  • Strong business, financial, operational, and technical acumen
  • Ability to analyze business and industry trends to develop tailored solutions aligned to the Staples value proposition
  • Ability to operate independently with minimal day-to-day supervision while maintaining alignment with broader team objectives

Qualifications

  • Demonstrated ability to build and maintain strong customer relationships across complex organizations
  • Customer-focused mindset with a commitment to delivering value and driving long-term partnerships •
  • Proven industry experience with established relationships and understanding of enterprise customer environments
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at multiple levels
  • Strong negotiation skills with the ability to navigate complex discussions and drive mutually beneficial outcomes
  • Ability to address complex challenges, influence decision-making, and drive alignment across stakeholders
  • High level of personal maturity and emotional intelligence
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret business data and make informed, fact-based decisions
  • Strong presentation skills with the ability to deliver compelling messaging to internal and external audiences
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate and work effectively across cross-functional teams
  • Understanding of healthcare terminology and industry dynamics (preferred for healthcare-focused accounts)
  • Understanding of supply chain processes and enterprise purchasing environments
  • Working knowledge of multiple lines of business and how they integrate to deliver customer solutions
  • Willingness to travel up to 50% as needed

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working within healthcare, IDN, or GPO-driven environments
  • Experience managing or supporting enterprise print or marketing programs across multi-location organizations
  • Familiarity with print production, distribution, and supply chain processes
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams including Sales, Category, Pricing, and Operations
  • Experience supporting program implementation, adoption, and performance tracking within large accounts

We Offer

  • Inclusive culture with associate-led Business Resource Groups
  • Flexible PTO (22 days) and Holiday Schedule (7 observed paid holidays)
  • Online and Retail Discounts, Company Match 401(k), Physical and Mental Health Wellness programs, and more!
  • Base salary 100k - 135K plus commissions

Location: Remote — United States

Reports To: CEO / CTO

Employment Type: Full-Time

Our Vision

At Flosum, we believe every enterprise running Salesforce deserves a platform that makes innovation fearless — where teams ship faster, data is never lost, and security is never an afterthought. Our vision is to become the undisputed global market leader in Salesforce-native DevSecOps and Data Protection, the default choice for every Fortune 500, government agency, and regulated enterprise that trusts Salesforce with their most critical business. We're building the category, and we're looking for a leader who will help us take it.

The Opportunity

This is a builder's role. As Director of Salesforce Development, you will shape the technical heart of a company on a mission to redefine how the world's largest enterprises protect, deploy, and scale on Salesforce. You'll partner directly with the CEO and executive team, own the architecture of our DevOps and Data Backup platforms, and lead the engineers whose work sits inside some of the most important Salesforce orgs on the planet.

If you want to look back in five years and say, "I helped build the market leader" — this is your seat.

What You'll Own

  • The end-to-end technical architecture across Salesforce (Apex, LWC, Metadata API) and Node.js systems that power our DevSecOps and Data Protection platform
  • The roadmap and delivery of our Salesforce DevOps capabilities — version control, CI/CD, automated merge, org comparison, and continuous deployment
  • The architecture and reliability of our Salesforce data backup, disaster recovery, and archival products trusted by regulated enterprises
  • Direct leadership, coaching, and accountability for a team of Salesforce and Node.js engineers — no layers, no diffusion of ownership
  • Training Node.js engineers into strong Salesforce platform contributors with a 1–2 month ramp
  • Setting the engineering bar, removing bottlenecks, and making the final technical call so execution never stalls
  • Partnering with Security, Product, and GTM leaders to ensure every release meets the standards of the world's most demanding customers

Requirements

What You Bring

  • 10+ years in software development with 3+ years leading engineering team
  • Deep Salesforce architecture mastery: Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, Metadata & Tooling APIs, Platform Events, and governor-limit-aware design
  • Proven Salesforce DevOps expertise — source-driven development, CI/CD, sandbox strategy, and the KPIs that matter: lead time, deployment frequency, change failure rate
  • Hands-on experience architecting Salesforce data backup, recovery, and archival systems at enterprise scale
  • Strong production Node.js experience and the ability to own architecture that spans Salesforce and Node services
  • A track record of owning outcomes — not tasks — and holding teams to a high bar
  • Enterprise experience in regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, government, insurance) strongly preferred

Nice to Have

  • Salesforce Certified Technical Architect (CTA), Application Architect, or System Architecticted
  • Familiarity with SOC 2, HIPAA, or FedRAMP compliance in the Salesforce ecosystem
  • Prior experience building ISV or AppExchange-native products

Who You Are

  • A builder who runs toward ambiguity and leaves clarity in your wak
  • A leader who can look at a team, see the gaps in 30 days, and close them in 90
  • A decision-maker who is comfortable being accountable — and who earns trust by being right more often than not
  • A coach who can turn strong Node.js engineers into strong Salesforce engineer

Why Flosum

You'll join a Salesforce Summit Partner and Innovation Award winner at the exact inflection point where category leadership is being decided. You'll have the autonomy of a founder, the resources of a scaled company, and a direct line to the executives setting the strategy. The work you ship will protect the Salesforce data and accelerate the Salesforce innovation of the world's most important enterprises

We're not looking for someone to manage what exists. We're looking for the leader who will help us become #1 — and build the team that gets us there.

Benefits

Competitive US-market base salary, performance bonus, meaningful equity, comprehensive medical/dental/vision, 401(k), and fully remote flexibility across the United States.

Quais serão as suas principais responsabilidades

1. Elaboração e Implementação de Modelos de Qualidade

  • Desenvolver e implementar modelos, políticas e ferramentas de controle de qualidade.
  • Atuar na disseminação de boas práticas e técnicas de melhoria contínua.

2. Planejamento e Execução de Testes

  • Definir estratégias de testes alinhadas ao negócio e à arquitetura.
  • Elaborar planos e cenários de testes.
  • Executar testes funcionais, de performance, regressão, entre outros.

3. Testes Automatizados e Frameworks

  • Utilizar e manter ferramentas de automação, incluindo:
    • Rest Assured, Cucumber, Cypress, JMeter e Bruno para testes end-to-end (E2E) em aplicações web.
    • Postman e Newman para testes de APIs.

4. Práticas de CI/CD

  • Atuar com pipelines de Integração e Entrega Contínuas (CI/CD).
  • Configurar e manter etapas de testes automatizados em ferramentas como:
    • GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD ou Jenkins.

5. Controle de Qualidade e Estratégias de Teste

  • Aplicar diferentes tipos de testes: unitários, integração, sistema e aceitação do usuário.
  • Trabalhar com estratégias como:
    • Test Driven Development (TDD)
    • Behavior Driven Development (BDD)
  • Gerenciar defeitos utilizando ferramentas de rastreamento, como JIRA.

6. Segurança, Desempenho e Escalabilidade

  • Executar testes de desempenho e carga, utilizando:
    • JMeter, LoadRunner ou ferramentas específicas de cloud.

    • Total de Defeitos Detectados (TDD)
    • Total de Defeitos Encontrados pelo Cliente (TDC)

    • Eficácia na Detecção de Defeitos (EDD)
      • Fórmula: EDD = TDD / (TDD + TDC) x 100
    • Tempo Médio de Reparo (MTTR)

title: Product Designer / Designer de Produto
description: THE OPPORTUNITY At Busbud, we connect millions of travelers with buses, coaches, and trains across 80+ countries.

raw.title: Product Designer / Designer de Produto
raw.excerpt: THE OPPORTUNITY At Busbud, we connect millions of travelers with buses, coaches, and trains across 80+ countries.
raw.description:
THE OPPORTUNITY

At Busbud, we connect millions of travelers with buses, coaches, and trains across 80+ countries. Design is how we make that feel effortless.

As a Product Designer, you’ll sit at the intersection of design, technology, and business, turning complex ideas into intuitive, well-crafted experiences that solve real problems for real people. You won’t just be designing the experience; you’ll be an active partner in defining it. You’ll focus on consolidating and elevating our web experience across our family of brands (Busbud, Buson, Recorrido, and more), working in a tight-knit team of two designers and reporting to the Lead Product Designer.

A OPPORTUNIDADE

Na Busbud, conectamos milhões de viajantes a ônibus, autocares e trens em mais de 80 países. O design é a forma como tornamos essa experiência simples e fluida.

Como Designer de Produto, você estará na interseção entre design, tecnologia e negócios, transformando ideias complexas em experiências intuitivas e bem elaboradas que resolvem problemas reais para pessoas reais. Você não estará apenas projetando a experiência; será um parceiro ativo na sua definição.

Você terá foco na consolidação e evolução da nossa experiência web em toda a nossa família de marcas (Busbud, Buson, Recorrido, entre outras), trabalhando em uma equipe próxima de dois designers e reportando-se ao Lead Product Designer.

WHAT YOU’LL DO
  • End-to-End Ownership: Drive the full design lifecycle, from early-stage exploration and concept development to final hand-off and implementation.
  • Strategic Problem Solving: Partner with Product Managers and Engineers to define problems, translate business goals into design solutions, and ensure technical feasibility.
  • Craft & Execution: Leverage our robust design system to move directly from concept to high-fidelity execution, bypassing low-fidelity wireframing to prioritize speed and visual precision.
  • Iterative Design: Use data, user research, and performance metrics to continuously refine the product, moving fluidly between exploration and execution.
  • System Thinking: Contribute to and evolve our design systems to ensure a scalable, consistent, and efficient experience across the entire product.

O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER
  • Responsabilidade de ponta a ponta: Conduzir todo o ciclo de design, desde a exploração inicial e desenvolvimento de conceitos até a entrega final e implementação.
  • Resolução estratégica de problemas: Trabalhar em parceria com Product Managers e Engenheiros para definir problemas, traduzir objetivos de negócio em soluções de design e garantir viabilidade técnica.
  • Qualidade e execução: Utilizar nosso sólido sistema de design para ir diretamente do conceito à execução de alta fidelidade, evitando wireframes de baixa fidelidade para priorizar velocidade e precisão visual.
  • Design iterativo: Usar dados, pesquisas com usuários e métricas de performance para refinar continuamente o produto, transitando com fluidez entre exploração e execução.
  • Pensamento sistêmico: Contribuir e evoluir nossos sistemas de design para garantir uma experiência escalável, consistente e eficiente em todo o produto.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR
  • Foundational Excellence: 5+ years of experience in product or UX design, with a portfolio that demonstrates the ability to simplify complex problems with strong visual craft.
  • Collaborative Mindset: Experience working in cross-functional environments where you can communicate design decisions and storytell the vision to engineers, PMs, and leadership.
  • Technical Proficiency: Mastery of Figma and a solid understanding of scalable design practices, with fluency in English (written and spoken).
  • Quality & Autonomy: An obsessive attention to detail and the ability to own your time and priorities without hand-holding. We don’t believe in micromanagement.

Additional Assets
  • Experience with design systems and multi-brand product families.
  • Visual or graphic design skills.
  • Basic front-end knowledge (HTML/CSS).
  • Motion design or micro-interaction experience.

O QUE PROCURAMOS
  • Excelência fundamental: Mais de 5 anos de experiência em design de produto ou UX, com um portfólio que demonstre a capacidade de simplificar problemas complexos com forte qualidade visual.
  • Mentalidade colaborativa: Experiência trabalhando em ambientes multifuncionais, com habilidade para comunicar decisões de design e contar a visão para engenheiros, PMs e liderança.
  • Proficiência técnica: Domínio de Figma e bom entendimento de práticas de design escaláveis, com fluência em inglês (escrito e falado).
  • Qualidade e autonomia: Atenção obsessiva aos detalhes e capacidade de gerenciar seu tempo e prioridades sem necessidade de supervisão constante. Não acreditamos em microgerenciamento

Diferenciais
  • Experiência com sistemas de design e famílias de produtos multi-marca.
  • Habilidades em design visual ou gráfico.
  • Conhecimento básico de front-end (HTML/CSS).
  • Experiência com design ou microinterações.

THE IMPACT YOU’LL HAVE

Your work will directly influence the daily experience of millions of travelers, driving satisfaction and overall product success. By balancing user empathy with business objectives, you’ll help us build products that are both meaningful and highly functional.
  • Intuitive solutions that align with user needs and ship on time.
  • A maintainable, scalable design system that empowers the whole team.
  • Consistent, high-quality experiences that support our long-term business goals.

O IMPACTO QUE VOCÊ TERÁ

Seu trabalho influenciará diretamente a experiência diária de milhões de viajantes, impulsionando a satisfação e o sucesso geral do produto. Ao equilibrar empatia pelo usuário com objetivos de negócio, você ajudará a construir produtos significativos e altamente funcionais.
  • Soluções intuitivas alinhadas às necessidades dos usuários e entregues no prazo.
  • Um sistema de design sustentável e escalável que potencializa toda a equipe.
  • Experiências consistentes e de alta qualidade que apoiam nossos objetivos de negócio de longo prazo.

A day in the life:

Working closely with the Associate Media Director for high-level planning and direction, you’ll lead all day-to-day execution, optimization, and reporting. You’ll be the subject-matter expert in both internal and client meetings—driving strategy, presenting recommendations with confidence, and defending the work with data. You’ll guide an internal team to deliver smart, integrated paid media strategies across channels, ensuring our clients see real, sustained growth. This is a client-facing role, and your ability to lead conversations, shape direction, and influence outcomes is at the center of your impact.

Responsibilities:

  • Successful end-to-end management & strategic oversight of designated paid media accounts.
  • Meet pacing & KPI requirements for held accounts, ultimately working to move the goal posts & set improved performance expectations.
  • Own all paid media strategy, project ideation, road-mapping & testing, leading the team with confidence & direction.

  • Work with Account Managers & the Media Director to identify client goals, priorities & efficiency requirements, ultimately improving Paid Media’s contribution to business success.
  • Actively works to increase billing & channel support for existing media accounts & propose opportunities to expand media coverage for new accounts.
  • Continually work to learn new strategies, test new platforms & expand Cardinal’s paid media offerings.
  • Function as the primary point of contact both internally & externally for all ‘owned’ accounts responsible for pacing & performance of accounts.
  • Responsible for generating reporting, writing insights & communicating with the client for designated accounts.
  • Responsible for the ongoing maintenance of held accounts including but not limited to optimizations, structural updates, bidding methodologies, conversion types and copy revisions.
  • Full ownership of Paid Media strategy for assigned accounts, working with the Media Director as needed.
  • Responsible for strategic ideation on all accounts, designing & adjusting campaign strategies to meet each client’s business goals (and internal objectives).
  • Responsible for designing & deploying tests in accounts on a monthly & quarterly cadence (structural, targeting, creative & messaging, conversion, etc).
  • Responsible for continual testing, verification & improvement of full-funnel structures.

Role Requirements:

  • 6-10+ years of Paid Media experience

  • Experience driving paid media strategy, project road maps, media plans, competitive research, testing, and measurement frameworks for clients across multiple media channels.
  • Experience in campaign management & strategy across multiple platforms, including Google Ads, Bing Ads, Meta, Google Display, Programmatic Display, and Social (LinkedIn, TikTok, etc. are a plus).
  • Experience with full funnel strategy, video, and lead generation.
  • Experience with Google Analytics, GTM, conversion, and optimization strategy (GA4 knowledge is a plus).
  • Ability to write ad copy, guide creative strategy, identify asset requirements, and establish a creative testing cadence.
  • Client relationship management experience. Reporting insights, identifying & optimizing towards client business goals.
  • Team management experience.

At RTX, the world largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Raytheon brings the strength of more than 100 years of experience and renowned engineering expertise to meet the needs of today’s mission and stay ahead of tomorrow’s threat. We deliver solutions that help our nation and allies defend freedoms and deter aggression, creating a safer, more secure world. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

Our cybersecurity team is seeking a Senior Business Data Analyst to work Remotely.

The Business Data Analyst supports the organization by turning complex datasets into actionable insights. This role partners closely with business stakeholders to understand needs, define analytical approaches, and deliver data-driven recommendations that improve performance, optimize processes, and support strategic decision-making.

What You Will Do

  • Gather, analyze, and interpret large datasets from multiple sources to identify trends, patterns, and insights.
  • Build dashboards, reports, and visualizations to communicate findings to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Collaborate with business partners to define KPIs, reporting requirements, and data-driven solutions.
  • Conduct deep-dive analyses to support strategic initiatives, operational improvements, and forecasting.
  • Validate data accuracy and ensure quality throughout data pipelines and reporting processes.
  • Translate business needs into analytical requirements, working with security cross functional teams as needed.
  • Develop and maintain documentation related to data definitions, reports, processes, and workflows.
  • Support the development of automated reporting tools and self-service analytics capabilities.
  • Monitor business performance and proactively identify areas for improvement.
  • Present insights and recommendations to leadership in a clear, concise, and actionable manner

Qualifications You Must Have

  • Typically requires a University Degree or equivalent experience and minimum 5 years prior relevant experience, or an Advanced Degree in a related field and minimum 3 years experience.
  • Experience with data analysis tools such as SQL and Excel.
  • Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau).

Qualifications We Prefer

  • Experience with data modeling, ETL processes, or data warehousing concepts.
  • Knowledge of statistical analysis techniques or predictive modeling.
  • Familiarity with Agile or project management methodologies.
  • Experience working in cross-functional environments.

What We Offer

Our values drive our actions, behaviors, and performance with a vision for a safer, more connected world. At RTX we value: Trust, Respect, Accountability, Collaboration, and Innovation.
